title: Two-step to Boat (learn it before the show)
body:
boat's made for a two-step. here's the basic step so you're ready on the floor.

quick quick, slow slow. that's the whole thing.

script.visual: you and a partner on a dance floor
side or overhead angle on the feet, Boat playing
script.line: quick quick, slow slow. that’s it.

shot_list: you + a partner, clear side or overhead angle on the feet
Boat as the audio, count the step out loud so it’s easy to follow
media_notes: Placeholder uses the Boat cover art; the clip is you + a partner filmed to the shot list.
notes: Rides the huge Texas two-step search audience; tied to the Boat single.
